verdict.rationale: Netlify plugs into existing Git workflows: it auto-deploys on every push and builds preview URLs for each PR, and community users praise the GitHub integration (netlify-docs-1, netlify-docs-25, netlify-comm-7, netlify-comm-10). Its integrations directory lists mainstream frameworks such as Next.js, Remix, SvelteKit and Angular, and the CLI can deploy straight from a working directory, which makes CI use plausible. missing for 10: explicit docs on running deploys from third-party CI pipelines, any evidence about editor workflows, and clarity on how far you can avoid Netlify-specific config such as netlify.toml, which one user found poorly documented (netlify-comm-12).
